title: What if Earth stopped spinning for just one second?

lines.text: What would happen if the Earth suddenly stopped spinning for just one second?
lines.caps: What if Earth *stopped | spinning for | just *one second?

lines.text: At the equator, the surface of our planet whips around at roughly one thousand miles per hour.
lines.caps: The surface spins | at *1,000 miles | per *hour

lines.text: If the globe instantly froze, the atmosphere, oceans, and everything on the surface would keep moving due to inertia.
Humans, cars, and entire cities would instantly become supersonic missiles flying through the sky.
Massive oceanic walls would instantly surge miles inland, wiping out coastlines in colossal megatsunamis.
When the planet restarted one second later, absolute devastation would blanket the globe.
lines.caps: One second later | global devastation | is *complete

lines.text: Thankfully, our planetary angular momentum keeps us safely spinning forever.
